svg.title: Rare either way: NAION cases per 10,000 people on GLP-1 drugs vs other diabetes drugs
svg.desc: Cases of ischemic optic neuropathy (mostly NAION) per 10,000 people, GLP-1 drug vs comparator. Rutgers US claims study, 18 months: 8.5 vs 5.5 (3.0 extra). Swedish registers, 5 years: 12 vs 7 (about 5 extra). US veterans, 3 years: 39.07 vs 29.33 (9.98 extra). Novo Nordisk's pooled placebo-controlled semaglutide and liraglutide trials: about 0.3 vs 0.6 per 10,000 person-years (3 vs 5 confirmed cases), no increase.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
